subject: MSA + Order Form — logo asset governance, press embargo & confidentiality scope
messages:

To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@olive.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft press release + logo use request (MSA/OF)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the product demo helped a lot. Procurement asked us to attach a draft press release and to confirm a lightweight publicity clause for the MSA + order form so we can clear vendor comms with our marketing/legal teams.

Attached: olive_draft_press_release_v1.docx and our internal logo usage checklist. High-level asks from our side:
- Permission to use Redwood logo in the press release and on our case studies page (low-res logo, PNG/JPG).
- A 7‑day embargo window from the final sign date.
- Standard confidentiality carve-out that allows us to notify partners and investors per our investor notice obligations (we can share limited summary items only).

Can you send the contract language your legal team prefers, and any required asset-usage guidelines? We want to avoid multiple redlines turning into a delay.

Best,
Emma
Procurement Lead, Olive AI
emma.lopez@olive.ai

[Attachment: olive_draft_press_release_v1.docx]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft press release + logo use request (MSA/OF)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Olive's request. They want logo permission, a 7‑day embargo post-signature, and a carve-out to notify investors/partners.

Ask: can legal convert this into a few options we can present:
1) Minimal publicity clause (one-time press release & case study permission; Redwood approval required but approval window max 3 business days).
2) Reference-rights clause (ongoing usage for marketing; no testimonial language unless we approve).
3) Confidentiality carve-out language limited to investor/partner notice (with a max excerpt and no shared customer data).

Ben: if legal signs off on an option, are we okay offering a one-time logo permission in the order form and then escalating to a reference agreement for broader rights?

I attached Redwood's logo guidelines pdf.

—Olga
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_logo_guidelines.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft press release + logo use request (MSA/OF)

Thanks Olga — reviewed. I've drafted redlines for the MSA and a short Order Form paragraph. Key points below and attached redline PDF (marissa_redlines_msa_v2.pdf):

1) Press/Press Release: limit to a single, one-time press release tied to the initial public announcement. Redwood approval required and approval not to be unreasonably withheld; approval turnaround set to three (3) business days. Add explicit embargo handling: press release may not be published before the later of (a) the execution date, or (b) the agreed embargo date in writing.

2) Logo Use: permit use of Redwood logo in the press release and low-resolution collateral only; commercial or productized use (e.g., badges, co-branded assets for resale) requires separate trademark license. Provide the logo guidelines as an exhibit.

3) Reference/Case Study Rights: allow Olive to reference the existence of the commercial relationship and high-level, non-confidential descriptive statements (no performance metrics or customer data) for marketing purposes. Any quotes attributing Redwood require prior written consent.

4) Confidentiality carve-out: limited carve-out for investor and partner notice is acceptable, but must be narrowly tailored — allow disclosure of the existence of the relationship and a one-paragraph summary of scope; no sharing of technical config, customer PII, or support logs. Require receipt of a list of parties who will receive notices and a one-time NDA flowdown if any party requests further details.

5) Liability/Indemnity impact: none beyond our standard language.

I'll attach the redline. Ben — I've marked the OF language as a customer-favorable concession (one-time press + 3 business day approval). If we want to offer broader reference rights, we should position that as a separate reference agreement after go-live.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: marissa_redlines_msa_v2.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft press release + logo use request (MSA/OF)

Perfect — thanks Marissa. My suggested commercial handling:
- Offer the one-time press release + logo permission in the Order Form (limited to the asset types Marissa specified).
- Include a simple upsell: a 12‑month reference addendum that Olive can buy (or we can include as a post-sign commercial conversation) to get broader case-study rights.
- Approve the 3-business-day review window — that keeps signatures moving.

Olga: if you get Olive to confirm the embargo target date and the list of internal folks who will see the release, I can give the go-ahead to include the clause in the customer-facing OF.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:34:00 -07:00

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Clarifications from our side: 
- Embargo: target publication window is Apr 20, 2028. We need to sign by Apr 13 to meet marketing timelines.
- Investors/Partners carve-out: we'll limit broadly shared summary items to a one-paragraph summary and provide the list of recipients for the flowdown. We confirm no PII or performance metrics will be included.
- Order Form ask: the OF signature page is the desired trigger for the one-time press release permission.

If you can send the redline language as a short snippet for insertion into the OF (single paragraph) we'll circulate internally today.

Emma
